detail.longDescription: I am working through the AWS step functions example WaitForCallback and modifying it to see how to make it work with my requirements . In the step that starts and waits for the callback, I would like to pass a custom JSON object to the message body that is sent to SQS and then on to lambda. My custom JSON object is received by the step function as follows: { "MyCustomObject": { "field1": "value1", "field2": "value2" } } I want to add the task token to a field in this JSON object and send that resulting object to the lambda as follows: { "MyCustomObject": { "field1": "value1", "field2": "value2", "TaskToken": "abcd1234" } } For reference, here is the example step: "Start Task And Wait For Callback": { "QueryLanguage": "JSONata", "Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::sqs:sendMessage.waitForTaskToken", "Arguments": { "QueueUrl": "https://sqs.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/11111111/StepFunctionsSample-WaitForCallback", "MessageBody": { "MessageTitle": "Task started by Step Functions. Waiting for callback with task token.", "TaskToken": "{% $states.context.Task.Token %}" } }, I have been reading through the AWS docs on jsonpath and jsonata, but I have been unable to figure out how to make this work - can anyone help?
